comment: What the party says when a hero dies, after the fight is over (src/farewell.cpp). {dead} = the fallen hero's first name, {town} = the nearest town. 'profiles' gives each hero an AD&D alignment (LG NG CG LN N CN LE NE CE) and a role (cleric, druid or none), keyed by first name; the nomads' are my own invention. Heroes not listed are neutral good (recruited refugees). Edit freely.
good: Oh, poor {dead}. Not like this.
I can't believe it. {dead} is gone.
{dead}... no. Please, no.
We were supposed to get through this together, {dead}.
It should not have ended this way for {dead}.
I am so sorry, {dead}. So very sorry.
{dead} fought bravely to the very end.
I never even got to thank {dead}.
By all the gods, {dead} deserved better than this.
I can't make myself believe it. Not {dead}.
We'll remember you, {dead}. Every one of us.
{dead} was braver than any of us knew.
This hurts more than any wound I've taken.
Gone, just like that. Poor {dead}.
I keep waiting for {dead} to get up.
We could not save you, {dead}. Forgive us.
The world is poorer without {dead}.
I should have been faster. Forgive me, {dead}.
{dead} gave everything for this company.
Our hearts are heavy, {dead}. We shall not forget you.
Such a loss. I can hardly speak.
I'm so sorry, {dead}. I truly am.
It's hard to see {dead} like this.
We were friends, {dead}. I will miss you.
{dead} didn't deserve this.
How many more must fall? Poor {dead}.
I can't believe we lost {dead}.
Rest now, {dead}. The fight is over for you.
The road will feel longer without {dead}.
If I could trade places, {dead}, I would.
Somebody should have been there. I am so sorry, {dead}.
{dead} was the best of us.
No more battles for you, {dead}. Be at peace.
I never thought it would be {dead}.
I wish we'd had one more night around the fire, {dead}.
There was kindness in {dead} that this war could not take.
I will carry {dead}'s memory with me always.
It was an honour to fight beside {dead}.
What a terrible, terrible waste. Poor {dead}.
We'll finish this for you, {dead}. I promise.
Gods, {dead}... I'm so sorry.
Tell me this isn't real. {dead}, get up.
I'm not ready to say goodbye, {dead}.
The dragons have taken so much, and now {dead}.
Brave {dead}. Brave, brave {dead}.
We'll make it mean something, {dead}.
I can't stop shaking. {dead} is really gone.
Poor, poor {dead}. May the dragons pay for this.
{dead} would have wanted us to go on. But oh, it hurts.
You've earned your rest, {dead}.
good_vs_evil: Whatever {dead} was, no one should die like that.
{dead} chose a dark road, but I'll not rejoice at the end of it.
I did not trust {dead}, but I'm sorry it ended this way.
Even {dead} deserved a chance to change.
May {dead} find more mercy than was shown in life.
A sad end for {dead}. Let it be a lesson to us all.
I'd have liked to see {dead} turn from that path.
Not a death I'd wish on anyone, not even {dead}.
neutral: Well. That's {dead} gone.
{dead} fell. It was bound to happen to someone.
A pity about {dead}. I'm sorry.
I'm sorry for the loss. {dead} was a good fighter.
Poor {dead}. This war takes everyone in the end.
We'll miss {dead}. That much is certain.
I didn't know {dead} well, but this is a loss.
{dead} knew the risks. We all do.
Sad business, {dead}'s end.
Such is the way of war. I'm sorry, {dead}.
It's a hard thing, losing {dead}.
I hoped {dead} would see this through.
{dead} did their part. More than their part.
Rest, {dead}. We carry on.
Quiet now. {dead} is gone.
One fewer sword, and one more grief.
I regret this, {dead}. Truly.
The balance has been paid today, and it's cruel.
{dead} will be missed.
Well fought, {dead}. It wasn't enough, but well fought.
Nothing to be done now. Farewell, {dead}.
We'll mourn later. For now, {dead} is gone.
A loss. A real loss.
Another name for the long list. Farewell, {dead}.
I'm sorry, {dead}. I really am.
evil_vs_good: Heh. So much for all that noble nonsense, {dead}.
Goodness is a fine way to get killed, {dead}.
Well, {dead} wanted to be a hero. Congratulations.
I did warn {dead} about charging in.
One less do-gooder to listen to.
Don't look at me. I'm not the one who got killed.
Dead heroes are the only kind the bards like.
Shame. I'd just got used to {dead}'s speeches.
Their loss. And, I suppose, ours. Barely.
Such a waste of a decent sword arm.
{dead} died doing the right thing. How tiresome.
evil_vs_neutral: {dead} never did know when to duck.
Oh well. {dead} had it coming sooner or later.
What a waste. Of a perfectly good pack, too.
{dead} was a fool, but a useful one.
I'll take {dead}'s share of the loot, then.
Well, that's one less mouth to feed.
evil_vs_evil: Well, {dead} went out fighting. I'll drink to that.
Shame. {dead} was almost as bad as me.
{dead} was a right piece of work. I'll miss that.
They broke {dead}, in the end. Not bad for them.
One of the good ones, {dead}. Meaning one of the bad ones.
{dead} had a mean streak I admired.
Pour one out for {dead}. Then take their boots.
cleric_good_for_good: May the angels descend and carry you to your reward, {dead}.
Go in peace, {dead}. The gods are waiting.
May the gods receive you with open arms, {dead}.
Sleep well, {dead}. Your watch is over.
May you walk in light now, {dead}, forever.
Rest in peace, {dead}. You've earned it a hundred times over.
May a better world than this one welcome you, {dead}.
Fly free, {dead}, beyond the reach of any dragon.
The gods have gained a good soul today. Rest, {dead}.
May the stars watch over you, {dead}. Rest in peace.
cleric_good_for_neutral: I mourn your loss, {dead}. I am so very sorry.
I hope you find your final peace, {dead}.
May you find your way, {dead}, wherever the road leads.
I grieve for you, {dead}. May the gods be gentle.
I wish you peace, {dead}, and an end to all your wandering.
Go gently, {dead}. I hope the road ahead is kind.
I'm so sorry, {dead}. I wish I'd been able to do more.
May you find rest, {dead}, whatever lies beyond.
My heart is heavy for you, {dead}. Find your peace.
I hope you find what you were looking for, {dead}.
cleric_good_for_evil: May the gods show you more mercy than you showed, {dead}.
I pray it is not too late for you, {dead}.
Whatever you did, {dead}, I hope you find forgiveness.
May the light find you even now, {dead}.
I do not condemn you, {dead}. May you find peace.
Even you, {dead}. Rest, and be forgiven.
cleric_neutral: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust.
The balance takes us all in the end. Farewell, {dead}.
From dust you came, {dead}, and to dust you return.
What is born must fall. Farewell, {dead}.
Peace to you, {dead}. The cycle goes on.
The scales are level now. Farewell, {dead}.
druid: From the ground we rise, and to the ground we go.
The earth takes you back, {dead}. Be one with it.
As the leaves fall, so do we. Farewell, {dead}.
Return to the soil, {dead}. Let the green grow from you.
From the ground we rise, {dead}. To the ground we go.
The wheel of the seasons turns. Rest, {dead}.
Nature gives and nature takes. Go back to her, {dead}.
May the roots hold you, {dead}, and the rain be gentle.
cleric_evil_lawful: Rest in power. You did your duty.
Your service is done, {dead}. Rest in power.
cleric_evil_other: {dead} was a fool anyway.
What a waste. And what a fool.
Well. {dead} is dead. How surprising.
{dead} should have watched their back.
Oh well. Their loss.
Not even worth the prayer.
{dead} was weak. Now {dead} is worm food.
Typical. {dead} never could keep out of trouble.
A fool's death for a fool.
Pathetic. Absolutely pathetic.
{dead} had it coming, and I won't pretend otherwise.
Don't expect tears from me.
Can't say I'm surprised, {dead}.
Dead, and no great loss.
One mistake too many, {dead}.
Next time, {dead}, try not dying.
The gods weren't listening to {dead} today.
I'll not waste a word on {dead}.
Oh well. What a waste of a fine corpse.
{dead} wasn't clever enough to live.
Poor {dead}. Poor, stupid {dead}.
Think of it as a lesson. {dead} did not.
That's what comes of poor judgement.
I've seen better men fall. I've seen worse, too.
{dead} spent their luck. We all do, eventually.
Ha. {dead} always did talk bigger than they fought.
Whatever. We move on.
{dead} was a burden. Don't pretend otherwise.
Some are made for glory, some for the ground. {dead} chose the ground.
Not my business. Not my loss.
pray_long: [{who} kneels and prays for a few moments]
[{who} lays a hand on {dead} and prays]
carry: We'll take {dead} back to {town} when this is over.
{dead} should rest in {town}. We'll bring {dead} there.
return: We'll come back for {dead}'s body when we're done here.
We cannot carry {dead} now. We'll return when it's over.
We'll bury {dead} properly once this is finished.
Leave {dead} in peace for now. We'll come back for the body.
